title: The Garlic Bread Is Missing
prerequisites: Can make a simple request with could
objective: Report one missing order item, name it exactly, request replacement or refund, and confirm the chosen outcome.

scenario.customer_need: The receipt lists soup, garlic bread, and apple juice. The bag contains only soup and juice.
scenario.staff_answer: We can send the garlic bread or refund that item. Which would you prefer?

model.report: My order is missing the garlic bread.
model.request_replacement: Could you send a replacement, please?
model.request_refund: Could I have a refund for that item, please?
model.confirm: I'd like the replacement, please. Could you confirm when it will arrive?
model.meaning_note: Missing means the named item is absent. A replacement sends the item. A refund returns its cost.
model.grammar_note: Use My order is missing + item. Use Could you + action for service. Use Could I have + noun for an outcome.
model.appropriateness_note: Name the exact item. State one preferred outcome. Confirm its timing or destination.

activities.prompt: Which message matches the receipt and bag?

options.feedback: The delivery arrived. Time is not the problem.

options.text: My order is missing the garlic bread.
options.feedback: This identifies the problem and names the absent item.
The soup matches the receipt. This reports the wrong problem.

activities.prompt: Support offers replacement or refund. Which reply chooses one outcome?

options.feedback: This does not choose replacement or refund.

options.text: Could you send a replacement, please?
options.feedback: This chooses replacement and keeps the request clear.
This is vague. It does not identify the requested outcome.

transfer_task.scenario: Your takeaway receipt lists curry and rice. Only the curry arrived. You finished eating, so you want the rice refunded.
transfer_task.instruction: Write two sentences. Name the missing item. Request the refund. Add one confirmation question.
acceptable_responses: My order is missing the rice. Could I have a refund for that item, please? Could you confirm the refund amount?
The rice is missing from my order. I'd like a refund for the rice, please. When should I receive it?

retrieval_prompt: Tomorrow, ask: Which four details make a missing-item report useful?

visual.summary: A four-step paper path: compare receipt and bag, name the missing item, choose replacement or refund, then confirm details.
visual.alt_text: Four layered paper cards connect receipt evidence to a missing garlic bread label, then branch toward replacement or refund, and finish at confirmation.
visual.text_equivalent: CHECK EVIDENCE -> NAME MISSING ITEM -> CHOOSE OUTCOME -> CONFIRM DETAILS

scenes.caption: Compare receipt and bag.
scenes.motion: Receipt slides beside the bag. Item cards rise from both.

scenes.caption: Name the missing item.
scenes.motion: The garlic bread label lifts from the receipt. A message card opens.

scenes.caption: Choose replacement or refund.
scenes.motion: The path splits. A van and refund coin move onto separate branches.

scenes.caption: Confirm the details.
scenes.motion: The replacement route closes. A confirmation ticket unfolds with timing.
